changes_from_1.2.0: ONE new term in P: p_joint, a correlation-aware joint plausibility term (joint.mjs). Everything else is v1.2.0 unchanged.

p_joint = empirical tail probability of the Mahalanobis distance of the log10 trait vector under a multivariate Gaussian fitted on benchmark DEV positives, with the design’s own family (every family: entry in reference_set_excluding) held out of the fit exactly, by subtracting that family’s sufficient statistics

two trait blocks, because the two large sources measure different traits: fishshapes (9 traits) and fishbase (10 traits); the block with more traits present is used, and the marginal sub-block covers whatever subset is present (minimum 3 traits)

calibration: q = D^2/d of real DEV positives under LEAVE-OWN-FAMILY-OUT, 101 quantiles per (block, dimension), so p answers "how often is a real fish whose family the model never saw at least this far out?"
p_joint enters P under the same alpha transform as the other calibrated p-values: min(1, p/0.05); P stays a min over its parts, times the coverage factor
the joint term reports WHICH trait pair is in an impossible combination (the off-diagonal contributions to D^2, with the correlation among real fish), so a low score is explainable
weights, floor, alpha, cut, evidence map, per-trait envelopes, definitional and organ rules, Lean gate, coverage factor and rank_score: unchanged from v1.2.0

joint.model: multivariate Gaussian on log10 traits, complete cases per block
